files./home/agent/.codex/config.toml:
model = "{{model}}"
model_provider = "bifrost"
allow_login_shell = false
check_for_update_on_startup = false
web_search = "disabled"

[analytics]
enabled = false

[feedback]
enabled = false

[history]
persistence = "none"

[otel]
exporter = "none"
log_user_prompt = false

[features]
memories = false

[shell_environment_policy]
exclude = ["BIFROST_API_KEY"]

[model_providers.bifrost]
name = "Bifrost"
base_url = "{{gateway.url}}/openai/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
env_key = "BIFROST_API_KEY"
requires_openai_auth = false
supports_websockets = false

[model_providers.bifrost.http_headers]
x-bf-session-id = "{{run.session}}"
x-bf-session-affinity = "off"
